title: R3-SEC4: is_dev_mode ignores client_certs/trusted_issuers
description: auth/config.rs is_dev_mode() returns true when !required and no users/credential_file, even if client_certs or trusted_issuers are configured. JMAP middleware bypasses all auth in this case. Fix: also check client_certs.is_empty() and trusted_issuers.is_empty().
